scope: Final Stage-2 authority and pinned TensorDiffEq README/package/environment metadata were inspected statically; framework capabilities, environment and license evidence remain source-scoped.

unresolved_findings.finding: Stage 2 verified no repository license file or GitHub license metadata, while setup.py carries an MIT classifier; the classifier is not promoted to repository SPDX authority.
requirements.txt and Pipfile leave core TensorFlow/scientific dependencies unpinned in their direct declarations.
Multiple environment manifests coexist and were not runtime-normalized or cross-resolved in Stage 3.
Multi-worker/multi-GPU and self-adaptive solver claims are documentation-scoped; no scientific workload was executed.
Repository examples are not promoted to standalone Stage-3 experiments without a separately bounded scientific case.

scope: Final Stage-2 authority and pinned IDRLnet README, requirements and package metadata were inspected statically; framework capabilities, environment/install and bundled-reference-data scope are retained without manufacturing experiments.

unresolved_findings.finding: Several requirements remain unversioned despite pinned versions for major numerical and ML dependencies.
No full immutable transitive environment lock was established in the assessed static scope.
Bundled Navier-Stokes CSV sample/test files remain example/reference inputs and are not generalized into a standalone research dataset.
Documented framework capabilities and installation routes were not executed or benchmarked in Stage 3.
Examples/tutorials are retained as framework documentation rather than standalone Stage-3 experiments.
